name: Hinduism
overview: Scripture reveals that true cleansing from sin and idolatry comes only through God’s power, as He promises to purify His people from all filthiness and idols. While the spirit returns to God at death, eternal life is granted exclusively to those who believe in the Son, Jesus Christ, whose judgment is just and aligned with the Father’s will. The truth of Christ sets believers free, warning that false teachers and deceptive miracles arise to lead many astray. Therefore, the Christian faith calls for discernment and steadfast trust in Jesus alone for salvation and freedom from spiritual deception.
